title: "Feature: Admin and Counsellor Dashboards"

## Problem
No admin or counsellor dashboard exists for managing students or activities.

## Solution
- Admin dashboard for managing students and activities
- Counsellor dashboard for viewing assigned students and their activities

## Acceptance Criteria
- Admin/counsellor can access dashboards after login
- Dashboards show relevant data and actions
